principles: A negative is unattributed until a positive control shares its address and credentials (COUNTERFEIT-REACH 09-22; BUILT_BUT_NOT_RESOLVED 08-17)
Prove a check can fail before trusting that it passed; a detector written from one remembered instance covers exactly one instance (BUILT_BUT_NOT_RESOLVED 08-17)
A distribution needs its draw checked, not just its parameters (BLOCKER_CLEARANCE §1)
A reader without a producer is the same frozen constant with a longer code path; reader, producer and storage must all survive (BLOCKER_CLEARANCE §3, §19)
Untracking from git and providing at runtime are two separate tasks (BLOCKER_CLEARANCE §30)
A success marker written on the wrong evidence is worse than none: it disarms the retry (BUILT_BUT_NOT_RESOLVED top)
Present in repo and build but absent from behaviour = propagation question, not logic question (BUILT_BUT_NOT_RESOLVED)
Committed != pushed != converged != running != exercised (BUILT_BUT_NOT_RESOLVED 20:06)
A test that pins a silent default pins the confabulation (BLOCKER_CLEARANCE §13.2)
A wrong answer that looks right is worse than no answer (BLOCKER_CLEARANCE §13.2)
A verifier must represent every dimension the goal can vary; else abstain; a shared parse must be complete (BUILT_BUT_NOT_RESOLVED 14:04-14:28)
